Workshop holds

Held without a service assignment. No release is confirmed; these buses are excluded from the operating fleet and service priorities.

Fleet utilization

In-service bus minutes ÷ assigned fleet minutes within the morning window.

Passenger load

Onboard passengers ÷ observed bus capacity, weighted across stop calls.

Queue after boarding

Largest remaining queue at a service-direction stop visit. Stops with queue = positions with any remaining queue ÷ observed boarding-stop positions.
